description: Adds a file to the library as a new item; nothing existing is replaced. With `url`, the user's browser fetches it, so only public https hosts that send CORS headers work. `data` takes base64 bytes and is limited to about 700 KB, for small generated assets. Larger files on the caller's disk can be sent as an HTTP POST of the raw bytes to /media/upload?token=TOKEN&name=NAME on this server's origin (up to 10 MB).

folder.description: Folder to put it in. Omit for the root.

token.description: The session token that connect returned.

url.description: http(s) URL for the browser to fetch.

name: put_media
title: Add media from a URL
